incident.summary: The direct-domain/session-topology correction and logical deliberation admission passed their tests, but subsequent review showed that a raw ChatGPT GitHub connector could still mutate unprotected production main outside Python ActionCoordinator. The semantic/domain topology remains corrected; the mutation-safety closure is reopened until the host enforcement follow-up closes the bypass.

root_cause: Deliberation was implemented as a pure selector before 2.4.3 and then made a logical fail-closed admission gate.
Closure verification was upgraded from file-local to authority-wide, but initially did not include every external host control surface capable of bypassing the claimed mutation invariant.
The parent/child business-gateway assumption was corrected, while production mutation topology still relied on direct-main CAS and an unprotected raw connector path.

followup.reason: Known raw-connector production bypass means complete mediation was not established; v1.6 forbids RESOLVED while that bypass remains active.

MICRO_DIAGNOSIS: production ENTRYPOINT retained stale same-task-id Financial rule after prior closure
fresh-chat bootstrap pointer retained mandatory-UAOS-routing wording
later host-level review found unprotected main plus raw connector outside Python enforcement
MACRO_GOAL_AND_TOPOLOGY_ALIGNMENT: registered child Agents must be independently usable work planes while UAOS remains the parent control/governance plane
production mutation must use complete mediation rather than only logical admission
GOVERNING_ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE: rejected assumption: parent authority implies mandatory runtime/business gateway
rejected assumption: common capability inheritance implies parent ownership of child business identity/state
rejected assumption: logical model/Python gate plus CAS is equivalent to physical enforcement
EXTERNAL_METHOD_OR_ARCHITECTURE_RESEARCH: Erlang/OTP supervisor versus child worker separation
COUNTEREXAMPLE_SEARCH: mandatory parent proxy creates single-point coupling and contradicts domain-owned business authority
parent-created shared business identity caused the observed Financial coupling and authority drift
direct-main raw connector write is a concrete counterexample to complete mediation
INDEPENDENT_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE: GitHub hosted full CI run 38579600772 PASS
GitHub hosted live-integration run 38579600785 PASS for PostgreSQL/DBOS/crash-recovery/S3 protocol
GitHub production main CI run 38579983855 PASS

implemented_changes: Frozen v1.5 direct-child-session, identity-boundary, cognitive-admission and authority-wide-closure requirements.
Corrected ENTRYPOINT, session policy, common capabilities and fresh-chat pointer so selecting a registered child activates that child directly as current Agent/work plane.
Made adaptive deliberation a fail-closed material-change admission contract and added executable require_deliberation_admission evidence checks.
Required authority-wide contradiction scan before evolution closure.
Corrected readiness from Financial 0.8.2/same-ID semantics to Financial 0.8.3/domain-owned identity semantics.
Added CI architecture regressions for parent-gateway, same-ID, stale bootstrap/readiness and deliberation-bypass failures.

details: A temporary noop file was accidentally written directly to main through the raw GitHub connector and immediately reverted.
The initial evolution record was also created directly on main before the candidate branch was established rather than through the intended CAS promotion path.
maintenance_process_deviation.impact: No child business authority or production runtime behavior was overwritten, but the event proves the logical gate was not a complete production enforcement point.
maintenance_process_deviation.preventive_link: Superseded by EVO-20261014-COMPLETE-MEDIATION-HOST-ENFORCEMENT; the known bypass now blocks RESOLVED until GitHub host enforcement is active and verified.
